sn34.41-45:1.2: samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo.
sn34.41-45:1.3: samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo.
sn34.41-45:1.4: neva samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo.
sn34.41-45:1.5: samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca.
